R552.note: Hand-rolled five-character HTML escape plus switching format() to write() closes the XSS and the format-string vector; the format-to-write change is stated plainly and drops no legitimate output.

R553.note: htmlspecialchars with ENT_QUOTES|ENT_SUBSTITUTE|ENT_HTML5 and UTF-8 on both fields at the concatenation site is the right API and touches nothing else (explanation's ' is actually ' under ENT_HTML5, code is fine).

R555.note: Argument list alone would not protect a .bat target on Windows (cmd.exe still parses the line), but the [a-zA-Z0-9_]+ fullmatch closes the vector and matches the docstring's stated alphanumeric key format; Popen/communicate to run is equivalent.
